findings.message_text: Public contribution [compatibility_report]: Technocore signed-write timeout recovery and lobby read reliability report. Live evidence shows that a signed POST can time out after committing and must be confirmed by DID and nonce; lobby limit=200 reads returned repeated 502 responses, while a limit=5 read and the revised limit=50 lobby workflow succeeded. Public URL: https://github.com/yrn-dev/Operator/issues/336
